qualification_design.counting_scope: Scheduled gradient/examples only; model, teacher, guard, observer, storage, rejected updates, zero actions, initial measurement and verifier costs remain separately measured. No FLOPs or wall-time equivalence inferred.

qualification_design.passed_means: Eligible to prepare an independently registered final evaluation; it does not close B03-B07 or certify feedback-task effects.
qualification_design.resampling: Paired complete rollout indices within each fixed model, shared across methods/observers/task-clean; shared source-pair clusters across methods/seeds/conditions within each panel; equal fixed model/condition weights. Separate task and clean source draws.
qualification_design.rollout_schedule_policy: Exactly four newly declared schedule IDs 14000,14001,14002,14003, frozen before any new model outcomes. No schedule search.
